overview: A quirky comic portrait of the everyday loves, fears and triumphs of a group of New Yorkers in the immediate aftermath of the failed 1993 World Trade Center bombing, NO FRIENDS consists of the first two seasons of the sitcom "Friends" with the six main cast members (the "Friends") removed through editing. Shy immigrant Gunther is trying to get out more. Carol and Susan anxiously prepare for their wedding and first child. And is respectable dentist Dr Farber concealing a dark secret?
